name: Doctor on the Edge
description: In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

videos.title: The Doctor Sent to the Island
videos.overview: Dreading his post, Do Jiui arrives on Pyeondongdo, meets Yuk Hari, and begins harsh island life.

videos.title: The Woman Who Crosses the Line
videos.overview: Do Jiui meets the mysterious nurse Yuk Hari, and their line-crossing house calls begin.

videos.title: Getting Through Another Day
videos.overview: The village chief makes Jiui an outcast. Meanwhile, Hari and Chiyeon are stranded overnight.

videos.title: A Notorious Woman, a Pathetic Man
videos.overview: Jiui is shaken by Hari's past and rumors, and a storm-hit emergency leaves him paralyzed by trauma.

videos.title: Pyeondong Scandal
videos.overview: Hari nurses Jiui amidst hospital gossip. Meanwhile, on Pyeondongdo, Mija is in critical condition.

videos.title: An Unspeakable Secret
videos.overview: Jiui and Hari's relationship is tested by Mija as the county governor schemes over Deokhwa's rescue.

videos.title: Words Left Unsaid
videos.overview: Torn between love and hurt, Jiui and the hurt Hari drift apart, and Mija's condition worsens.

videos.title: I Can't Do It. I Can't Ignore You.
videos.overview: Grieving her grandma, a downpour forces Hari to live with Jiui. Amid mix emotions, a secret emerges.

videos.title: Courage to Forgive
videos.overview: Jiui and Hari confirm their feelings, illness spreads on Jineondo, and a man appears before Jucheon.

videos.title: It's Not Okay
videos.overview: A crash shatters Jiui. As his first love Hwayeong returns, Hari must decide whether to let him go.

videos.title: Reconciliation, Healing, And...
videos.overview: Amid a confession and a breakup ahead, a misdiagnosed case returns, and Jiui stands at a crossroads.

videos.title: If I Just Tough It Out, Things Will Work Out Somehow!
videos.overview: The governor's risky deal could save the public health center. Will Jiui resist or compromise?
